title: Leonidas consults the Oracle of Delphi before fighting the Persians

tellings.quote: Leonitis goes to visit the Oracle of Deli to determine as to whether or not they should fight against the Persians.

plain: Before fighting the Persians, the Spartan king Leonidas went to the Oracle of Delphi, a priestess at a Greek shrine, to ask whether they should go to war. The researcher Luke Caverns tells this on the show as an old story, without naming a source, as an example of rulers seeking guidance from such sites.
